questions.q: What comes next? LMN, OPQ, RST, UVW, …
questions.why: Each group starts 3 letters after the last one, with the same pattern inside: XYZ. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Pointing to a woman, Ravi (a man) said, "She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son." How is the woman related to Ravi?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Sister. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: A shopkeeper marks an item 30% above cost and gives a 10% discount. What is the overall gain?
Manoj walks 5 m West, then turns left and walks 9 m, then turns right and walks 9 m. Which direction is Manoj facing now?
questions.why: Follow each turn from the first direction: the last leg is towards the West. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Statements: Some cats are dogs. No dogs are pets. Conclusions: I. Some cats are not pets. II. Some pets are cats.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I must be true, II need not be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: From a point P on level ground, the top of a 100 m tower is at an elevation of 30°. How far is P from the foot of the tower?
If 6 jerseys are given to each player, one player gets only 4. If 4 are given to each, 30 are left over. How many jerseys and players?
questions.why: 6p − 2 = 4p + 30, so p = 16 and jerseys = 94. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.

questions.q: Statements: No pens are books. All books are bags. Conclusions: I. Some pens are bags. II. Some bags are not pens.
questions.why: Checked against every possible diagram of the statements: I need not be true, II must be true. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Which one is the odd one out?
questions.why: Rembrandt was a painter; the others were composers. GPSC CBRT, Mar 2025.
